fields.title: Tech stack record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of the technologies detected on one site, matched against 87 fingerprints. One SITE row per domain, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows for domains that could not be fetched. Unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The normalised URL this record answers for.

_scrapedAt.title: Checked at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: dns_failure, tls_failure, timeout, connection_failed, http_error, unreachable or unexpected_error. Each is a fact about the prospect, not about the run.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The hostname as supplied, normalised to lowercase.

url.title: URL
url.description: The https URL that was requested.

finalUrl.title: Final URL
finalUrl.description: Where the request ended after redirects.

redirected.title: Redirected
redirected.description: True when the site redirected to a different hostname - the detected stack then belongs to that host, not the one supplied.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: Whether the site answered at all.

pageBytes.title: Page bytes
pageBytes.description: Size of the HTML that was analysed.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: Every technology detected, confirmed ones first.

technologiesConfirmed.title: Confirmed technologies
technologiesConfirmed.description: Only those proven by an unforgeable signal such as a vendor cookie or vendor CDN host.

confirmedCount.title: Confirmed count
confirmedCount.description: How many of those are confirmed rather than likely.

categoriesDetected.title: Categories detected
categoriesDetected.description: Which technology categories this site has anything in.

detections.title: Detections
detections.description: Per technology: category, confidence, which signal types matched and the exact evidence string for each. Omit with includeEvidence=false.

sitesWithNoDetections.title: Sites with no detections
sitesWithNoDetections.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: reachable sites where nothing in the table matched - usually plain static sites or holding pages.

technologyRanking.title: Technology ranking
technologyRanking.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: the top 40 technologies across the list with a site count and share.

stackEcommerce.title: Ecommerce
stackEcommerce.description: Store platform detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackCMS.description: Content management detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackAnalytics.title: Analytics

stackTagManager.title: Tag Manager
stackTagManager.description: Tag and script management detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackMarketing.description: Marketing automation, email and ads detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackSupport.title: Support
stackSupport.description: Live chat and helpdesk detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackPayments.description: Checkout and payment processing detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackReviews.title: Reviews
stackReviews.description: Ratings and user reviews detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackSearch.description: On-site search and discovery detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackMonitoring.title: Monitoring
stackMonitoring.description: Error and performance monitoring detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

stackExperimentation.title: Experimentation
stackExperimentation.description: A/B testing and personalisation detected on this site, comma separated. Empty when none.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per site with the headline stack.

martech.title: Marketing stack
